program_text: program 11 CIS - Computer Sci and Info Systems Foundations of Data Science COA_Foundations of Data Science Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) Foundations of Data Science New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. The Foundations of Data Science Certificate of Achievement introduces the tools, methods and theories used in data analysis and data-driven decision-making. The program is designed for those with limited programming and statistics experience. Through hands-on application of data wrangling, statistical analysis, data visualization and machine learning basics, students learn to apply core data science concepts in various fields, paving the way for more advanced studies in data science and artificial intelligence. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Design, code, document, analyze, debug and test introductory-level Python programs Calculate and interpret basic statistics in a dataset and apply basic regression and classification techniques for predictions Design and implement reports and dashboards for data and trends analysis using technologies like Tableau, Power BI, BIRT or Pentaho De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics. Total Units Students must complete at least 90 degree-applicable quarter units, including required major courses and GE courses At least 24 of those 90 units must be completed at De Anza College All De Anza courses must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 All 90 degree units, including courses transferred from other institutions, must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 General Education Students must complete all requirements for one of the General Education (GE) patterns listed at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements Courses applied to GE requirements must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 Students earning an A.A. or A.S. degree must complete ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5 with a grade of C or higher All courses applied to the Cal-GETC pathway must be completed with minimum grade of C Courses in the major can be use
